Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL4818987. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return all rows including duplicates. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
